verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an optional strict publishing flow that requires a separate Approver's sign-off before a policy is published. Marketing copy also says it automates creating, reviewing, and acknowledging published policies and creating policies in minutes, which points to employee acknowledgment and some templating. Missing for 10: evidence of a lawyer-grade policy template library (only a single HIPAA breach-notification template is documented), a documented policy editor, policy version history, detailed per-employee acceptance tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
